description: Discover this unique 4‑bedroom duplex apartment in the heart of the 16th arrondissement, just steps from Trocadéro. This spacious and stylish apartment can accommodate up to 8 guests and features a large rooftop terrace perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy modern design and a truly memorable Parisian stay.The spaceDiscover this spacious apartment of 180 sqmfeaturing:* Bright and spacious living room with comfortable designer sofas* Fully equipped open kitchen* Master bedroom: king-size bed, huge dressing room, and en-suite bathroom (shower, bathtub, double sink)* Second bedroom: queen-size bed with connecting bathroom shared with the third bedroom (shower, WC)* Third bedroom: queen-size bed with shared bathroom and storage* Fourth bedroom upstairs with queen-size bed and direct access to the terrace* Twp extra toilets (living room and upstairs)* Very large rooftop terrace with hammock, covered bar, and outdoor loungeGuest accessFull access to the apartment for a fully independent stay.Other things to note* 180 sqm (1930 sq.ft) + 60 sqm terrace* High-speed Wi-Fi* Elevator access* Baby crib provided* Quiet building* Portable AC units* Four bedrooms (8 guests)* Bed linen, towels, and toiletries provided* Private driver / airport transfer on requestPlease contact us for any additional requests.We look forward to hosting you!
